consent.title: Cookies
consent.body: We use Google Analytics to see how the site is used. It only sets cookies if you accept.

lanner
hero.title: Turn a run into a plan
hero.subtitle: See who used which cooldown and when, then export it straight into the addon for your group.

scan.title: Scan a run
scan.hint: The link must point to a single run: ?fight=3, #fight=3 or ?fight=last.
scan.forceHelp: Ignores the stored version and queries Warcraft Logs again. Costs ~5 API points.

paste.title: Paste a link
paste.text: A Warcraft Logs report pointing to a specific run.

read.title: Read the timeline
read.text: Every player's cooldowns, boss by boss, against the boss abilities.

export.title: Export the plan
export.text: Copy the ECP plan for one boss or the whole dungeon into the addon.

addon.title: Get the ECP addon
addon.text: Plans exported from this site are read by Eiiko Cooldown Planner in game. Install it to see your healing and defensive cooldowns called out against every boss ability.

run.missingSpells: {{count}} spell(s) cast but missing from the catalog, not shown: <mono>{{ids}}</mono>. Either they left the catalog after the scan, or the loaded catalog is stale - a hard refresh tells which.

filters.ecpPresetHelp: Shows the run as the ECP export reads it: healing and external spells, each aligned on the boss ability it answers. Filters stay adjustable. Click again to leave and show everything.

playerSpells.hiddenByCategory: Already hidden by the category filter
playerSpells.showPlayer: Hidden - click to show this player
playerSpells.none: No tracked spell on this boss.

ecp.exportBossHelp: Overwrites the {{boss}} plan in the open variant
ecp.exportDungeonHelp: Creates a variant covering the whole dungeon
ecp.copied: Copied - {{length}} characters. Paste it into the addon.
ecp.copiedWithFingerprint: Copied - {{length}} characters · fingerprint {{fingerprint}}. Paste it into the addon.
ecp.clipboardRefused: The browser blocked the copy. Fetch it from /api/runs/{{reportCode}}/{{fightID}}/ecp

spells.title: Spell catalog
spells.count: {{count}} spells. Hover an icon for its Wowhead tooltip.

home.title: Dashboard
home.intro: The 9 tables of the schema. The two pivot tables (dashed) have no page of their own: they are edited from their parent's record - a spell_spec without its spell means nothing.

pivots.dungeonSeasonsEmpty: No season - this dungeon won't be recognized in any report.
pivots.seasonDungeonsEmpty: No dungeon linked - the scan won't resolve any encounterID.
pivots.spellSpecsEmpty: No spec: cross-class spell, always included in the scan.

timers.title: Timer extraction
timers.intro: Every curated ability of a boss, at each occurrence, timed from the pull and averaged over the selected fights. Occurrences are matched by rank (the 3rd cast against the 3rd cast). Coverage only counts fights still running at that time.
timers.outdatedHelp: Scanned with an older spell set: abilities added since (aliases) are missing. Unchecked by default.
timers.noResult: No timer: select at least one fight, or lower the minimum coverage.

dev.title: Dev tools
dev.searchPlaceholder: Search a scan by ID (report code or CODE-fight)
dev.rescanHelp: Queries Warcraft Logs again for this run and replaces the stored version. Costs ~5 API points.
